title: Maximum XOR Subarray
description: Given an integer array `nums` of non-negative integers, find the maximum possible bitwise XOR value among all non-empty contiguous subarrays `nums[l..r]` (`0 <= l <= r < nums.length`).
hints: Every subarray XOR `nums[l..r]` equals `pref[r + 1] ^ pref[l]`, reducing the problem to finding the maximum XOR between two prefix XORs (including `pref[0] = 0`).
Insert prefix XORs from MSB (bit 29) to LSB (bit 0) into a binary trie and greedily take the opposite bit branch at each level when querying.

examples.explanation: The subarray [1, 2, 12] has XOR 1 ^ 2 ^ 12 = 15, which is the maximum possible.
The entire array [4, 6] has XOR 4 ^ 6 = 2, while single subarray [6] has XOR 6.
The subarray [1, 2, 3, 4] has XOR 4, while [3, 4] has XOR 7.
